Name: Daru Dayu (from Show by Rock) Replaces Leah (Content Patcher)
Author: waffletoast215
Description:
This mod replaces Leah's sprites and portraits with Daru Dayu from the anime/game series Show by Rock!! Includes regular AND beach versions! Tsurezure Naru Ayatsuri Mugenan's drummer and vocalist has arrived in Stardew Valley! 

        -Every single Leah sprite has been replaced with the millenia-old master of Far Eastern music, Daru Dayu!
        -Because she is majestic, Daru Dayu floats instead of walks!
        -Replaces Leah's wedding outfit with one based on Daru Dayu's white outfit in Show by Rock Fes a Live!
        -Replaces Leah's beach outfit with one based one of her UR outfits in the original Show by Rock game!
       -NEW: Gives her a winter outfit based on one from a bromide from one of the previous Show by Rock games. 


Use SMAPI/Content Patcher to use this mod!
This mod DOES NOT change Leah's name or any dialogue. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271?tab=files&file_id=51404]You can use this one to change her name to match![/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271?tab=files&file_id=51404]
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2668?tab=files&file_id=11023]Here is the UI mod shown [/url]in the example photos!

Contains both edited Leah sprites and original sprites, all made by me. 
Enjoy! Please do not repost my sprites/use them in other projects without permission!
